episodes.title: How People Get Pulled Into Cults | Susan Rosenbluth on "Blurred Vision"
episodes.description: Moshe welcomed Susan Rosenbluth, longtime editor and publisher of the "Jewish Voice and Opinion," for a wide-ranging conversation about her journey in journalism and the mission that inspired her to create a voice for “classical Judaism.” Now, Susan is taking on a new role as a novelist with her debut book, "Blurred Vision." She shares the true story that inspired the novel, her decades long interest in cults and why maintaining a strong connection to Judaism can be so important in times of vulnerability. A fascinating conversation about journalism, Jewish identity, writing and the experiences that shaped Susan's life and work. Subscribe to our channel: https://www.youtube.com/@jewishlinknews
